chunks: Jaʿfar ibn ʿUbaydullāh ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (peace be upon them), the possessor of ancestry. He fabricates ḥadīth.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ النُّسْبِ: Possessor of ancestry; a title indicating noble lineage, often used for descendants of the Prophet or Imams.
key_terms.عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ: Peace be upon them; honorific used for multiple Imams or family members.
key_terms.يَضَعُ الْحَدِيثَ: He fabricates hadith; a technical term in hadith sciences indicating the narrator is known for inventing or fabricating narrations.

ai.seo_question: Who is Jaʿfar ibn ʿUbaydullāh and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry for Jaʿfar ibn  al-ʿUbaydullāh, a descendant of the Prophet's family (Ahl al-Bayt). He is characterized as 'Sahib al-Nusb' (possessor of ancestry) and is noted for 'Yadʿu al--Ḥadīth' (fabricating hadith), indicating a specific critique of his reliability or method in transmitting narrations.
